visible_progression: Proof 001 preserves the first bounded cross-carrier seam split between source validity or invalidity and visible receiving-side ingress or refusal.
Proof 002 preserves the contaminated receiving parser or governance case in which technical receipt can occur while lawful ingress is still denied.
Proof 003 preserves the receiver-local embodied contamination case in which the same valid package diverges by receiving-side local condition.
family_level_notes.bounded_reading: The family remains a set of distinct bounded cross-carrier proof turns rather than one flat transfer story. Proof 001, proof 002, and proof 003 preserve different seam concerns and together form a growing body of cross-carrier seam evidence without implying full relational field, mesh, or middleware.
